title: Sherpa voice ASR UI validation: Cohere Transcribe (en)
description: Drives the /features/asr screen end-to-end with the Cohere Transcribe model and the bundled `en.wav` test sample, asserting the transcript displayed in the UI is non-empty (i.e. not '(no speech detected)'). Requires the Cohere model to be downloaded on the target device. KNOWN FLAKY: Cohere lands at the bottom of the model picker FlatList; `findFiberByTestId` + `press` cannot reliably reach off-screen virtualized rows. Use `asr-cohere-roundtrip` (bridge-level) for stable validation until the recipe runner gains a scroll-to-testID-visible primitive.

prepare-ready-0.intent: The sherpa-voice app is running with the agentic bridge installed.
